decisions.reason: The multi-model laser workstation line builds on the firm's established laser offer and represents sunk development investment, so management will persist even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business and has kept its own page for two years, signalling ongoing commitment to the firm's single-source technology-matching strategy.
The piezo inkjet printer completes the high-resolution portfolio, fits the firm's goal of matching technology to surface, and has stayed visibly presented, so it is likely to be retained.

This recently launched laser line is featured on the home page and is central to the firm's announced direction, so the strong public commitment and the investment behind it make dropping it very unlikely.
The compact laser cabin is a new launch with its own page, and any weak early results can be attributed to the start-up phase, so management will keep it.
The lubricant printing system won a trade fair award that management has publicised, so this validated, specialised product justifies continued commitment.
